maintenance.requirements: The Codex desktop and local host must be available with authenticated GitHub and Sites access.

verification.note: Browser checks used the exact local static output subsequently packaged and deployed; archive bytes were compared with that output. Library search/filter/empty states, glossary links, section anchors, mobile navigation and all four interactive examples were checked. The authenticated production browser reached an owner passkey challenge, so production deployment and owner-private access are confirmed by the native Sites result rather than a signed-in browser inspection. No scientific model runs were performed.
